# WiderLens Website

A React + TypeScript + Vite brand website for WiderLens, a Hong Kong professional eyewear and optometry service.

## Quick Start

```bash
cd app
bun install
bun run dev
```

## Documentation

- [THEMES.md](./THEMES.md) — color theme configuration and customization guide
- [app/AGENTS.md](./app/AGENTS.md) — development conventions and architecture notes
